scientific_integrity: Classical cyclic-core enumeration and Rayleigh law are acknowledged as prior results, not newly asserted discoveries.
All limit claims have explicit proofs; the finite exact checker is a reproducibility diagnostic rather than an infinite proof.
A same-model review only; no independent verification or certification is represented.
scientific_limitations: Only uniform independent-image mappings; fixed natural labels and weak point-process convergence.
Higher moment ratios concern each fixed integer order; no uniform estimate over growing order or quantitative point-process rate.
Historical priority remains subject to review of older mapping-statistics sources unavailable as full text.
title: Mixed Poisson first cyclic labels and a critical moment spectrum in uniform random mappings
